propositions: src/rebar/llm/config.py at 793 LOC is at the 800-line cap with only 7 lines of headroom, blocking new knobs like REBAR_LLM_MODEL deprecation aliases.

The gate read-root/snapshot-session domain (ContextVars and 11 functions across config.py:51-152 and :190-269) comprises 219 inert lines that have had zero growth since 2026-07-09 and are only consumed by llm/gate_source.py.

Extracting the gate domain to a new gate_context.py module with re-exports from config.py preserves the monkeypatch contract: every consumer uses a function-level import from config, so test patches on config continue to rebind correctly at call time.

The moved assert_gated function's logger identity must be re-pointed from the hardcoded 'rebar.llm.config' to 'rebar.llm.gate_context' and tested, because the security-audited REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED override warning must be attributed to the module that contains the code.

The seam test's shared bound on workflow_ops.py and config.py must be split into per-file constraints: config.py tightened to < 700 (creating ~15 knobs of runway), workflow_ops.py left at 800 until its own extraction.

The extraction provides structural headroom but does not remove the per-knob absorber (10-13 LOC per new knob in from_env); durable follow-ups require teaching gen_env_registry.py to consume an exported spec list or domain-splitting knobs per feature cluster.
